newsitem.title: USA: One voter to decide local Florida election.
newsitem.headline: One voter to decide local Florida election.

text.p: Does one vote really make a difference? It does if you are the only registered voter in the election.
The state of Florida wants to develop Dutton Island into a regional park. To do that, voters both in Atlantic Beach and on Dutton Island must approve the idea on Tuesday.
Atlantic Beach has about 2,500 registered voters but Dutton Island has just one. Several people actually live on the island but only one is registered to vote.
Atlantic Beach City Manager Jim Jarboe declined to identify the voter, but if that person votes no a year of planning at the state, county and local level will be for nothing.

Local officials were not aware how low the voter turnout on Dutton Island would be until an employee in the supervisor of elections office realised she had prepared just one ballot for the election there.
